full_judgment: 11. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record in support of the petition has taken us through the impugned judgment and order and submits, inter-alia, that the High Court Division committed error of law in not holding that the plaintiff petitioner's mother transferred the suit property by the executing and registering the deed of gift and as such interference is called for.
